correctness.rationale: Signed irreducible excursions have exact Catalan weights; independent fair signs give \(\mathbb E[D_n^2\mid\ell_1,\ldots,\ell_k]=\sum_i\ell_i^2\). Differentiating the squared-size mark in the excursion generating function yields the coefficient \(n(n+3)4^n/4\) and the exact negative covariance. A separate bivariate OGF yields the uniform Chung–Feller sojourn law, exact variance, and limiting correlation; an exact enumerator and independently implemented weighted recurrence pass 92 parameter-case checks.

value.rationale: Return count is a natural discrete local-time observable and squared signed positive occupation is a natural imbalance. Their strong negative dependence is not visible from the uniform Chung–Feller marginal. Closed negative formula at every n and nonzero n→∞ correlation reveal an interpretable, structurally motivated bridge coupling. The calculation requires two independent combinatorial reductions and a nonobvious coefficient cancellation, not a trivial normalization or arbitrary finite slice.
